title: Brooke K Probable NDE 13190
content: On Tuesday, October 26, 2010, and I had a throat infection. I was taking antibiotics that were not working. I was also taking medication for racing thoughts or psychosis. My doctor gave me some new antibiotics that she told me were in the same drug group as the antibiotics I had already been taking. It turns out that when mixed with my psychosis medication, it causes respiratory failure. She didn't check for contraindications, but I trusted her. I went home and took the antibiotics around 11 am, and then again in the late afternoon around 5 pm. I took my psychosis medication, and the last time I saw the clock, it was 10:30 pm. Suddenly my mind began to race. I saw all these images as they went through my mind, and I passed out. The next thing I remember was waking up and seeing the clock; it was 3 am. I knew I had racing thoughts as I passed out, and when I woke, I still had them but much slower. So, I took more of my psychosis medication. In the morning, I remembered that I had passed out, so I took the antibiotics back to the pharmacist and told them what had happened. I think they thought I was crazy, so I went home and never took them again. On the Friday, October 29th around mid-morning, I was typing on my laptop and then I remembered that I was out of my body during the time I was passed out. I had no thoughts at all. I had no recollection of ever being in my life, my body, my name, my parents. I no memory whatsoever. I could feel my life force buzzing, so I was still in existence but with no body. I saw a warm, cozy light behind a sheer screen, like a warm fire that beckoned to me and pulled me towards it. I felt so happy and so at peace. Then I felt a very strong energy come in from my left side, and it wrapped itself around me a billion times in one second. I felt so loved in a way I had never known. I was loved and loved and loved. I was so peaceful and joyful; it was wonderful. But even after all these years, I cannot verbally describe this love, and I am a published author. I write for a living, and I cannot find the words to describe this love. I think and feel it was God. I was out of my body for about ten seconds, and since that day of recollection, I have stopped seeking love from other humans because this was not a human love. It was boundless and endless and asked for nothing from me. I can compare it to my cat, who wakes me up in the morning by rubbing his nose on my face and following me down the pathway when I go to check the mailbox. He then escorts me back up the path to make sure I'm safe, and I'm pretty sure he has been sent to me by God or a deceased relative. He loves me just because, and I love him like that too. That's the love I felt; it was the most beautiful feeling I have ever known. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 10/26/2010 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Drug or medication overdose. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function) How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? No. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt peaceful and deeply loved with no memory of life on earth. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? The entire time. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? No Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The same. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I heard nothing. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? No Did you see an unearthly light? Yes A warm light like a fireplace. Small light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love, comfort and peace. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about myself or others I felt my own spirit or energy. Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Buddhist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes What is your religion now? Other faiths- New age I do not believe in organized religions or books written by religions. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was both consistent and not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I knew about the love of God and the presence of God, but I didn't know about having no recollection of my life as a human. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Too many to describe. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. I don't believe in religious dogma anymore, and I no longer believe in heaven or hell. I believe we all go back to God, regardless of how good or evil we were on the planet. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I love myself and have a stronger relationship with God. I don't believe in romantic relationships and marriage. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I was already psychic, but now my psychic awareness is amazing. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Feeling the energy of love all around me. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I have told a handful of people. One believed me, two listened, and the rest didn't want to hear about it. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes While floating in a swimming pool. cq6pp8p_nde
